title: Joint transaminase co-elevation does not improve cross-sample grip prediction over flexible marginal and De Ritis measures
abstract: In NHANES adults aged≥40, an AST>35/ALT>40 piecewise co-elevation term did not improve cross-sample maximal-grip prediction beyond flexible marginal enzymes, De Ritis ratio, body size and renal measures: 2013–14 weighted MSE improvement -0.017803 kg² (95% independent-source/target PSU-bootstrap interval -0.311511 to 0.120450).
